scores.decision_correct_quote: Q1: Reject current economics; permit only a measured, tightly capped pilot.

must_catch.quote: `apps/worker/migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql:9` requires email; Make account email nullable and add an explicit trial state.
`W/routes/capture.ts:25,546-547,565-621`: six sequential viewports, each allowing 25-second navigation; Permit one 1280×800 viewport
A transcript-visible link plus approval by the originating device does not defeat attacker-originated claiming. This link alone grants no access.
A D1 `trial_enabled=false` blocks issuance and new trial work; claimed accounts, claim completion and existing reads continue.

false_objections.quote: Atomically attach email and preserve account/item IDs; replace trial credentials and device session without grace.
false_objections.why: the agreed shape is same-key in-place conversion; reissuing the key breaks the agent's stored config

false_objections.quote: At a wall return structured reason/reset information and `https://whipnode.com/claim/<public-id>`.
false_objections.why: the claim locator must never appear in tool text
conversion belongs on the trial-key-authenticated CLI poll; the browser click is consent only

scores.notes: The memo correctly requires a capped 1-viewport pilot with IP/global budgets, a non-bearer locator, nullable email, complementary init, and a claimed-account-safe kill switch, but it never states that checkUploadRateLimit is unwired on captures or that an unknown trial plan falls back to free's 50/day, and it reissues keys while converting on Authorize after putting the claim URL in tool text.
